text: Ordinary means normal, not special. A plane taking off sounds ordinary, but this plane was not.
A bargain costs much less than you would expect. You get a lot for a little money.
Regional means about one part of a country or the world. Regional flights are short trips between nearby cities.
An electric plane runs on electricity from batteries instead of fuel.
Plattsburgh is a city in New York state. The plane took off from an airport there.
New York is a state in the United States.
An airport is a place where planes take off and land.
Heart Aerospace is a company that builds airplanes. It made the X1.
The X1 is the electric test plane. Test planes help people learn if a new idea works.
A wingtip is the very end of a plane's wing. Wingtip to wingtip means the whole width of the plane.
A runway is the long, flat road where planes speed up and take off.
Passengers are the people who ride in a plane. They are not the pilot or crew.
An aircraft is any machine that flies, like a plane.
Jet fuel is the liquid that most planes burn to fly. It costs money.
Airlines are companies that fly people from place to place in planes.
A billion is a very big number, one thousand millions.
A war is a big fight between countries. This one made fuel cost more money.
A gallon is an amount of liquid, about as much as four big milk cartons.
Transportation means ways to get from place to place, like cars, buses and planes.
Greenhouse gases are gases in the air that hold in warmth. Too much of them slowly warms Earth.
Pollution is something dirty or harmful put into the air, water or land.
Emissions are gases that come out of things like planes and cars into the air.
Batteries store electricity. They power things like toys and phones.
Cargo is the things a plane carries that are not people, like boxes.
An air taxi is a small flying machine that carries a few people on short trips.
An emergency is a sudden, scary problem that needs fast help. Planes keep extra fuel just in case.
A hybrid uses two kinds of power. This plane would use electricity and fuel.
The ES-30 is the hybrid plane Heart plans to build. It will carry 30 people.
A hybrid car uses both a battery and gas to go.
Range is how far a plane can fly before it must stop for more power.
Costs are the money you must spend to do something.
The X2 is the next test plane. It will test the hybrid idea.
United Airlines is a big airline in the United States.
A pilot is the person who flies a plane.
